name: Jackrabbit
description: Inhabits leg augments and occasionally provides a burst of speed that exceeds the augment's rated output — a sprint faster than the hardware should allow, lasting 2-3 seconds.
observed_behavior: Temporarily overclocks servo motors beyond safety limits. The burst is brief enough to avoid damage but long enough to clear a gap, dodge a shot, or catch a bus.
story_hooks: A runner hits the burst during a pursuit and clears a gap they shouldn't have been able to — the gap between two buildings, four stories up
